# MarketCart CI

> Cart parity checks for Shopify stores on Dawn-family themes and Horizon 4.4. A real browser adds a product, then MarketCart CI compares the cart Shopify stored (/cart.js) with what the shopper sees (cart drawer or cart page): variant, quantity, line price, badge, total and the currency of the market the session actually got. JSON result plus exit code for CI. Open-source CLI and GitHub Action; hosted runs EUR 19 per 100 completed cases.
